title: Qualify to do business with the City

paragraphs: Find out which laws you need to comply with to become a City supplier and how to submit the appropriate forms.

sections.heading: Comply with the Equal Benefits Program
paragraphs: Most businesses that contract with the City of San Francisco must comply with the Equal Benefits Program (Article 131, formerly 12B).
This law requires the City to only contract with businesses that offer the same benefits to employees with domestic partners as employees with spouses.

sections.heading: Comply with other applicable laws
paragraphs: To do business with the City, suppliers may need to comply with several other ordinances.
Learn about requirements that may be applicable .

sections.heading: Get certified as an LBE
paragraphs: The Local Business Enterprise (LBE) Program helps small businesses compete for City contracts.
LBE certification is not required for bidding on City contracts or being a supplier, but it does help small businesses through the bidding process.
